card.name: Beijing Opera
card.tagline: China's premier theatrical art blending song, mime, acrobatics and dance
card.profile: Peking (Beijing) opera (京劇, Jīngjù) is the dominant form of Chinese opera, combining instrumental music, vocal performance, mime, martial arts, dance and acrobatics (English Wikipedia). It arose in Beijing in the mid-Qing dynasty and was fully developed by the mid-19th century, with four main role types: sheng, dan, jing and chou. It is not strictly a dance but contains substantial stylized dance and movement.
card.insight: Inscribed on UNESCO's Representative List of Intangible Cultural Heritage in 2010 (ref RL/00418), it is regarded as one of China's cultural treasures (UNESCO/Wikidata).
